title.narrative: CONSTRUCTION OF PA/DANO/COTE D'VOIRE BORDER ROAD PROJECT

description.narrative: THE OBJECTIVE OF THE PROJECT IS TO CONSTRUCT 232KM OF PAVED ROAD TO OPEN UP VERY LARGE PRODUCTION AREAS OF THE COUNTRY AND CONTRIBUTE IN THE REDUCTION OF THE TRANSPORT COST ON THE ROUTE BETWEEN BURKINA FASO AND COTE D'VOIRE.
